groups.title: AC Filter Replacements
groups.summary: A clogged or wrong-sized air filter restricts airflow through the entire system.
groups.intro: A clogged or wrong-sized air filter restricts airflow through the entire system, forces the blower motor to work harder, and significantly reduces the system’s ability to cool your home efficiently. It also allows dust and debris to accumulate on the evaporator coil over time, compounding the problem.

about.title: About Air Tech of Houston AC & Plumbing
text: The team here at Air Tech is dedicated to providing comprehensive Houston AC services to the community. Whether you’re in need of AC installation, maintenance or repair, our technicians can handle it all. Explore our seasonal HVAC tune-up specials.

We go above and beyond to make sure your air regulation is healthy and efficient, including offering filtrations systems and evaluating your attic insulation. Houston air conditioning services have never been more stress-free with Air Tech of Houston AC & Plumbing.

Air Tech knows that most of the year your heater is not a priority, but when that first cool front blows in, we’ll be ready. We are proud to provide expert Houston heating services, including installation, repair and maintenance to make sure your home stays warm.
